notes.title: CONTENT UPDATE - 04/MAR/2016 - Version: 0.5.0.283
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/TlZGTf6.jpg
Version: 0.5.0.283 is now live and contains the following additions and changes.

A new SKIRMISH game mode has been added. Shoot down aircraft and combo your way to high scores and take your last stand before being swallowed by the depths. 

http://i.imgur.com/y0KYtLp.jpg
We've included two new ships in this update, they'll currently only be available in skirmish mode but their chips will be added into the main campaign in the future. The Ausländer is a powerful small one gun vessel equipped with nukes to clear out hostiles within sight radius. The second addition to the fleet is the Jiguang, a two gun battleship with a mounted vertical laser.  

http://i.imgur.com/WeYHqkd.jpg
Full list of additions and changes:
[olist]
    New game icon.
    New launcher.
    New skirmish game mode.
    Boat wake effects.
    New water impact splash effects.
    Projectile water impact splash effects.
    Ausländer ship added to skirmish mode.
    Jiguang ship added to skirmish mode.
    Fix world map TIME text overlap.
    Joypad support in siege battles.
    Saboteur damage per second reduce from 6 to 2.
    New pause menu title backing explosion animation.
    Fixed snow shield deducting wrong chip quantity when used.
    Fixed darken present cannon payload at night.
    Fixed darken side component on the Claws Chariot at night.
    Fixed options menu back button in pause menu on top of cursor.
    Halloween chips added to clear save data on new game.
    Christmas chips added to clear save data on new game.
    Siege Joypad controls info added to the oceanic handbook.
    Updated siege keyboard/mouse controls info in the oceanic handbook.
[/olist]
Enjoy!!!

& don't get swallowed by the waves.

notes.title: CHRISTMAS UPDATE - 24/DEC/2015 - Version: 0.4.0.250
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/BZo6pSO.jpg
Version: 0.4.0.250 is now live and contains the following additions and changes.

To celebrate the holiday, this latest build includes a few fun Christmas themed items. We've added five new chips into the game with this festive update. There's a new boat, two weapons and two reinforcement chips.

http://i.imgur.com/PoyEvrD.jpg
The new ship is the Claws chariot, a large three gun slay. The new weapon chips are a Christmas tree that boosts doubloon acquisition by 20% and a present cannon to launch deadly gifts into the air battle raging above.

http://i.imgur.com/9JvfcE6.jpg
The two new reinforcement chips included are the first of this type of chip to be added to the game. One is an offensive airstrike with presents and the other a defensive snow shield.

More details on these new chips can be found in the game.

http://i.imgur.com/iodvJl6.jpg

Full list of additions and changes:
[olist]
    Claws chariot.
    Christmas tree.
    Gift Gun.
    Snow shield.
    Present Drop.
[/olist] 
Enjoy!!!

& don't get swallowed by the waves.

notes.title: PATCH - 01/DEC/2015 - Version: 0.3.1.243
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/D90B8ze.jpg
Version: 0.3.1.243 is now live and contains the following additions and changes.

This latest build includes a small patch addressing a few things before we put out our next big content update, scheduled for sometime in December before the new year.

Stat bars can now be found in the ship builder, all weapons have their bars up to date with the current weapon balancing in the game. Though, these are most likely going to change at some point in the future.

http://i.imgur.com/4TDHRt3.jpg
We've also added in an entry into the Oceanic Handbook for the viewfinder. It includes basic screen information and current keyboard control setups.

For balancing purposes the Halloween content chips have had their prices increased to match their strength and effectiveness. 

http://i.imgur.com/auxvyTL.jpg

Full list of additions and changes:
[olist]
    Gun stat bars.
    V-sync off by default.
    Options Menu back button fix.
    Viewfinder handbook entry.
    World map threat light cover.
    Corrected siege text in viewfinder.
    Volume slider shoot effects.
    Darkened gore cannon at night.
    Lightened gore cannon blood at night.
    Gore Cannon price increased to 15,000.
    Titan head price increased to 26,000.
    Samhain price increased to 35,000.
[/olist] 
Enjoy!!!

notes.title: CONTENT UPDATE - 08/NOV/2015 - Version 0.3.0.238
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/UQnX1Fa.jpg
Version: 0.3.0.238 is now live and contains the following additions and changes.

With this update you can now access the Marooned siege battle, located north of Eutopia in the land of Spite. You must lay waste to their stronghold.

http://i.imgur.com/PBujSZ6.jpg
You'll need to attack from afar. Long range armaments are a must due to heavy shoreline emplacements, making a landing close to impossible. 

Shield generators are housed inside fortified garrisons on the outer perimeter of the port. Once destroyed, the shield protecting the main structure will dissipate. Locate and destroy the final generator exposing the core target. Once defenses are down obliterate the HQ and claim victory.

http://i.imgur.com/ALQoTLD.jpg
The battle makes use of a new viewfinder system. You'll need to utilize three new weapons in order to make it through the battle in one piece. At your command is an Auto Cannon for use against light targets, a Bombard Cannon for heavy targets and a Rocket Battery for quick building destruction.

http://i.imgur.com/HL8zcIs.jpg
Enjoy!!!

& don't get swallowed by the waves.

notes.title: HALLOWEEN UPDATE - 31/OCT/2015 - Version: 0.2.0.234
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/paOUZEH.jpg
We wanted to celebrate the horror festivities with a few spooky treats for you all. We've added three new schematic chips into the game with this little holiday update. There's a new boat and two new weapons to instill fear in your foes at sea.

http://i.imgur.com/yyMHfhJ.jpg
The Samhain ship can house two weapon platforms and can release her resident wicked witches into the battle above, upon her captain's command.

The gore cannon is a purpose build body bit launcher, no longer will your enemies entrails go to waste. The second arsenal addition is an immortal titan's severed head that spits bats into the action.

http://i.imgur.com/QVYBl8f.jpg
The new chips can be found in Al's Store for a low 666 doubloons each. After NOV 4th the amount will increase to match their strength for balancing purposes. Both weapons are quite powerful when used efficiently.

http://i.imgur.com/PJsQ3xd.jpg
Crewmen can also be sacrificed to both weapons, for some ferocious fun.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JPqe18J_g4M
Enjoy!!!

& don't get swallowed by the waves.

Version: 0.1.3.210 is now live and contains the following additions and changes.

We've reworked the top information display in the world map. The Icons for time of day and weather have been split in two and moved to the side bumpers of the display. Time on the left and weather on the right.

Current time and day digital displays have been moved to a new lower section on the hud either side of the threat indicator.

http://i.imgur.com/TSGy64I.jpg

The Battle Manual has returned and is now contained inside the Oceanic handbook, you can find it in either the main menu or in the pause menu while playing, for ease of access. 

We have just included basic information for now but we'll be adding more tabs as we go that will include things such as maps, faction information, achievements acquired and much more.

http://i.imgur.com/TgqF9wc.jpg

notes.title: PATCH - 10/SEP/2015 - Version: 0.1.2.204
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/7lOrA6q.jpg

Version: 0.1.2.204 is now live and contains the following additions and changes.

We’ve added in a playable tutorial in place of the Oceanic Battle Manual that previously greeted players upon a new game. After creating your character you’ll now jump straight into the tutorial battle against one of the Orbs and learn the basics of the game’s battle mechanics. 

http://i.imgur.com/mJlQoRd.jpg

A button for the tutorial has also been added onto the list in the main menu for anyone wanting to play through the tutorial without resetting save data.

The Oceanic Battle Manual has been removed for now and is being reworked. It will be back in the game soon and accessible via the pause menu with updated functionality.

http://i.imgur.com/rfHx3F5.jpg

Full list of additions and changes:
[olist]
    New tutorial battle.
    Oceanic Battle Manual temporarily removed.
    Character creator instructional arrows added.
    Zoom tool-tip moved to center screen and now vanishes if cursor not over hud.
    NPC speech boxes lifted above cloud shadow in Eutopia.
    QF MK1 gun given a higher rate of fire for each burst.
    Construction Yard entry area increased.
    Al's Store entry area increased. 
[/olist] 
Enjoy!!!

notes.title: PATCH - 03/SEP/2015 - Version: 0.1.1.199
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/N2zoNnY.jpg

Patch 1 is our first little patch for the game since our launch onto early access. This is just a small update to quickly patch in a few tool-tips and a basic options menu for video settings and audio.

We’ve added in an audio slider for master volume, we’re currently working on a new sound system and once its finished and updated into the game we’ll be adding in more sound controls and customization. Video controls include fullscreen, v-sync, aa and resolution settings.

More options and customization will be added as we go through EARLY ACCESS and we work out whats wanted and needed.

http://i.imgur.com/UOqPLmR.jpg

Hovering over a crew types button will now display the crew types title.

There is also text to indicate controls to zoom into the ship control bays by holding  and indications on how to pan the screen left and right with  or .

You can also hold  to zoom and use  and  to pan the screen if preferred.

http://i.imgur.com/6I6ytTJ.jpg

We are currently hard at work on a more in-depth playable tutorial to make learning the game’s various mechanics more intuitive and slightly friendlier than the current Oceanic Battle Manual you see when you start a new game. The Oceanic Battle Manual will soon also be placed into the pause menu for further reference if needed.

Enjoy!!!

& don’t get swallowed by the waves.
